title: conversation vs navigation order
rule: Conversation: ask for the needed/desired action, then present risks. Navigation: Back on the left (previous step). Less important actions go right or bottom. Collapsed overflow content stays on the right.
pass_when: Conversation order is desired action then risks. Navigation has Back on the left. Less important / overflow sit right or bottom as cited.
fail_when: Risks before the needed action in a conversation pattern; Back not on the left in navigation; overflow collapsed to the left.
overview: Conversation asks for the action then risks; navigation keeps Back on the left.
apply_when: Ordering actions in Ant conversation dialogs or step navigation footers.
not_when: Platforms that mandate a different Back or commit order than Ant cites.
agent_hint: Ask desired action before risks; put Back left; park overflow right/bottom.
description: In Ant’s conversation pattern, ask for the needed or desired action, then present risks. In navigation, Back stays on the left for the previous step; less important actions and collapsed overflow sit right or bottom. Risks-first conversation order, Back off the left, or overflow collapsed leftward fight that guidance. Follow it on Ant button layouts; other platforms may prescribe different order.
